senses.en_definition: So that; in order that; introduces an intended purpose or result, or the content of a request or suggestion.

collocations.en: so as not to be late

messages.en: Our train's at nine, right? We should make it if we leave at eight, shouldn't we?
Let's leave a bit earlier, at seven thirty, so we're not rushing around later. We still have to find parking.
That character has a superpower—he can stop time!
Wow, I want to see that movie too!

senses.en_definition: A letter; a written message sent to another person.
A written or printed document, especially an official record, certificate, or agreement.
Writing or script; written words, chiefly in older usage or fixed expressions.
A chapter of the Quran; an archaic form of surah.

messages.en: Has that letter from the university arrived yet? Could you check the mailbox quickly?
There's a letter for you. Want me to open it?
Don't open it yet. Just leave it on the table. I'll read it when I get home.

senses.en_definition: To tell, ask, or order someone to do something.

collocations.en: tell someone to do some work

senses.en_definition: To send someone somewhere; to direct someone to go to a place.
A command or injunction to be obeyed, especially in religious or traditional usage.

messages.en: Mum asked me to get some bread from the shop. Do you want anything?
A carton of chocolate milk, please. But if they don't have any cold ones, don't bother.
Okay. I'll check when I get to the shop, then text you.
